## Frontend QA Run Complete — 2026-07-24 (s2)

**Result: full convergence — 0 bugs, 0 fixes, 0 commits.**

### Precondition (proves nothing changed)
- `git diff 2d7fb57..HEAD -- server/src client/src` → **empty**
- `git status --porcelain -- server/src client/src` → **empty** (only dirty files are QA artifacts: `.qa-*.txt/.json`, `claude-overnight-*.json` — no source)
- `git diff 2d7fb57..HEAD -- client/src/{components,pages}` → **empty** (no new/changed component or page files)
- `npx vite build` → **exit 0, 8.58s** (only pre-existing mapbox/index/Reports chunk-size warnings, 0 errors)

Frontend is byte-identical to the baseline converged across 16 backend runs / 12 UI audits.

### Fresh Playwright evidence (didn't trust stale memory)
| Page | Result |
|---|---|
| **/ Dashboard** | Full real data — pipeline $60K, New 16/Contacted 4/Appt 1/Inspected 1/Estimate Sent 1, live NWS storm feed (Jul 23 Wind/Hail +44 more), 4 overdue tasks, activity feed, Revenue-by-Source, AR $4.4K/5 inv, estimating 5.9%, days-in-stage, Team Leaderboard 4 reps. **Console 0 err / 0 warn** |
| **/pipeline, /leads, /estimates** | Render clean |
| **/settings** | All 15 tabs present (Profile, Company, Billing, Payments, Team, Storm Alerts, Notifications, Email/SMTP, Financing, Automations, Drip Sequences, Custom Fields, Pricing/Line Items, Contracts, Reviews); Profile shows real tenant data |
| **Console (cumulative)** | 0 real errors; 1 warning = Stripe.js 3rd-party HTTP dev notice (not our code) |

### Conclusion
Nothing is broken. The charter forbids enhancements/refactors, so there is nothing to fix. The two long-standing gaps (Esc-to-close keyboard nav = enhancement; EstimateBuilder at 375px = mobile, which is paused and works at 768px+) remain out-of-charter.

**No commit made** — charter says commit only after a fix, and there were none. Resume file updated for the next run: only re-test if the developer adds NEW route/page/component files (`git diff --stat 2d7fb57..HEAD -- client/src server/src` non-empty).
